title: G29 · 拒绝
body: I changed only matMul’s fused 2×2 kernel, giving each output two alternating exact partial-sum lanes so the eight-way group can sustain eight independent FMA dependency chains. The transpose, eight-way grouping, tails, fallback arithmetic, FMA safety checks, output representation, and all seven other exports remain unchanged; because the fused path admits only exactly representable integer products and sums, regrouping those additions is numerically identical while potentially providing the roughly 1.60× matrix gain needed to clear the aggregate threshold.
